summary: The app supports any observer height. A stored skyline is used only at the exact height it was built for; any other height runs the smooth sphere at grade D and is labelled so. All four heights (0, 2, 10 and 20 m) are shipped with 24 polar skylines each, so the selector marks every height as available and the mast comparison reports what each height changes. Adding another height is a build run with no code change.
